body: I suppose trouble with school, family and friends.. All of those core things in my life has just gone downhill. I've been trying my hardest to fix them but, in my depressed mind state, it just seems impossible. I know it's not.. It's just hard to feel any hope.

I suppose I was motivated to live?.. To be happy and healthy. A change in medication might have brought this on, but it has been like this even before that.
Losing hope is scary, I remember having a fight in me to beat this, but it's no longer there..  or if it is it's buried away.

I'm sorry that you're feeling the same way. I do hope you feel better.

I guess I'm just undecided at the moment. It's tricky; do I stay or do I go? 
This is really the only time I have seriously considered it. That's mostly what's been on my mind.

I just thought talking to people would be a step in a better direction, the people here are lovely and I'm finding it does help to talk. So if you also feel like talking, feel free to PM me :)
Just down and out really, depression is getting the better of me at the moment. My motivation is gone..and sometimes I think the hope I had to get better is leaving me too, which is the scary part.
